page_title: NEW 2-0 BUR | Newcastle v Burnley 30/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Alexander Isak is replaced by Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd).
90+6' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) for Miguel Almiron.
90+4' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Josh Cullen (Burnley). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
90+3' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the left side of the goal is far too weak and James Trafford makes a simple save.
88' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Sander Berge will be replaced by Anass Zaroury (Burnley).
88' That will be all from Connor Roberts who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Vitinho (Burnley).
88' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for an infringement.
87' Newcastle control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
84' Josh Cullen (Burnley) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Thomas Bramall blows for a foul.
81' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
80' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. Newcastle win a corner kick.
80' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
79' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Burnley comes to nothing.

79' Ameen Al Dakhil (Burnley) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper. The linesman points to the corner flag, Burnley are going to take it.
79' The ball goes out for a corner. Burnley can continue in their attacking effort.

79' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Burnley.
76' 2 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper James Trafford no chance!
76' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

75' Ameen Al Dakhil (Burnley) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Thomas Bramall blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Newcastle have been awarded a penalty kick!

73' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but James Trafford was alert and the score remains the same.
73' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
73' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner which is cleared.
72' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Good work from Newcastle as they win a corner.
71' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) brings his opponent down. Thomas Bramall has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Josh Cullen (Burnley) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
68' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Sandro Tonali replaces him.
67' Substitution. Aaron Ramsey will be replaced by Wilson Odobert (Burnley).
67' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) picks up an injury.
64' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) sends a teasing cross into the area, but James Trafford intercepts the ball.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Elliot Anderson leaves the pitch and Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
63' Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) brings an opponent down and Thomas Bramall interrupts the game.
61' Burnley are ruled offside.
58' Vincent Kompany has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) replacing Zeki Amdouni.
58' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) will replace Luca Koleosho.
57' A cross by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
53' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
50' Aaron Ramsey (Burnley) was too forceful with his tackle and Thomas Bramall interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
49' The Burnley players are exchanging some short passes.
46' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
46' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt. Corner kick. Newcastle will have an opportunity.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.

45+3' Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the right side of the goal. James Trafford is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
45+1' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 8:3.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Burnley force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
44' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) sends a cross into the box, but Nick Pope comes off his line to gather the ball.
42' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
41' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
40' Jordan Beyer (Burnley) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
38' Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
37' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
37' Poor challenge! Josh Cullen (Burnley) is penalised for tripping and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle.

35' What a save from James Trafford! Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising low header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
33' Josh Cullen (Burnley) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
32' Josh Cullen (Burnley) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
29' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Zeki Amdouni (Burnley).
27' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
27' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
26' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) is penalised for holding. Thomas Bramall signals a set piece.
23' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) is caught offside!
21' Alexander Isak races towards the box before laying off to Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd), who picks it up but drags a shot well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
20' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
18' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) receives a yellow card for infringement.
17' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.

14' 1 - 0 Goal! Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box inside the left post. James Trafford had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:0.
12' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

11' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. James Trafford pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
10' A pass by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
8' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) commits a rough challenge and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Newcastle seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

4' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Nick Pope shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Burnley will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Thomas Bramall.
